# Complete self-service reset page and password update

## Summary

Provide a logged-out reset experience: validate the token from the email link, show new password + confirmation, update bcrypt hash on success, mark the token used (single-use), increment `credentialVersion` so all prior sessions invalidate, and redirect to login with accessible error states for expired/invalid/reused tokens.

## Scope

- In scope: GET/POST (or equivalent) for reset completion; password rules aligned with existing `z.string().min(4)` unless product widens globally; clear errors with CTA back to forgot-password; increment credential version on success; integration tests for happy path and edge cases from PRD §3.
- Out of scope: Rate limiting (TICKET-005); polished shared email template (TICKET-007).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Valid token shows form for new password and confirmation; mismatch shows inline error without leaking account details (REQ-004).
- [ ] Successful submit hashes password with existing bcrypt cost pattern, marks reset token consumed, increments user `credentialVersion`, and prevents token reuse (REQ-003, REQ-004).
- [ ] Invalid, expired, or already-used token shows a safe message and link to request a new email (REQ-003, PRD §5 Errors).
- [ ] After success, user can log in with the new password; any previous `auth-user` cookies for that user fail `credentialVersion` check from TICKET-002 (REQ-005).
- [ ] Automated tests cover happy path, expired token, reused token, and non-admin/inactive if reachable via token integrity edge cases.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: TICKET-001, TICKET-002, TICKET-003
- Blocks: none

## Notes

Ensure self-service path and admin-initiated reset both use the same password-update + version-bump abstraction where practical to avoid drift.
